verdict.rationale: Deel provides a dedicated API Sandbox with pre-populated data for safely testing real API calls, plus a documented REST API and MCP tools reference, which supports hands-on experimentation. However, there is no explicit evidence of an interactive API reference page (e.g., embedded 'try it out' console) with runnable code examples directly in the docs UI. missing for 10: explicit interactive reference/try-it-out console in docs, runnable code snippets embedded in reference pages, independent corroboration of doc UX quality.
